description: Arcs set the emotional/genre shape layered over a template. Each arc defines its energy, tension curve, the kind of (always mild) conflict, and how it resolves. All arcs resolve warmly and safely; conflict never involves real peril, injury, cruelty, or an adult rescuing a passive child (see story-framework.json child_agency).

fields.peak_position: 0-1, where in the book tension is highest (fraction of pages)
fields.conflict_type: the mild problem that drives the middle
fields.resolution_style: how the child resolves it (their agency)

arcs.name: Adventure
arcs.conflict_type: a place to reach or cross
arcs.note: Movement and discovery; the challenge is the journey itself.

arcs.name: Funny
arcs.note: The 'challenge' is comic, never embarrassing or mean.

arcs.name: Friendly Contest
arcs.note: Everyone stays friends; winning is not the point, trying is.

arcs.name: Little Mystery
arcs.conflict_type: a small puzzle or missing thing
arcs.note: Curiosity, not fear; the 'mystery' is cozy.

arcs.name: Helping
arcs.note: Empathy-forward; the child chooses to help.

arcs.name: Learning a Skill
arcs.note: Models productive struggle; failure is safe and temporary.

arcs.name: Cozy / Calm
arcs.conflict_type: a small wish or quiet moment
arcs.note: Very low tension; ideal for the youngest levels and bedtime.
